job.title: Production Supervisor
job.description:
About the role:
  • Leadership role running a production shift across multiple lines
  • Temp-to-perm, with a clear view to a permanent position
  • Competitive pay rates

About the Business:
  • Family-owned business
  • Food manufacturing operating to GMP and HACCP standards
  • Growing team with genuine career progression

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead a safe workplace by enforcing WHS procedures and PPE, and running pre-start checks and toolbox talks
  • Plan and run each shift to hit daily output targets, delivery dates and order priorities
  • Track and improve line efficiency (OEE), record downtime and output, and act on the main losses
  • Make sure all product meets specification and GMP/HACCP standards, including line clearances, label and batch-code checks, weight checks and holding non-conforming product
  • Allocate staff to lines by skill and demand, and manage rosters, breaks, leave and overtime within labour budget
  • Coordinate quick, right-first-time changeovers, and work with maintenance to cut breakdowns and downtime
  • Keep batch records, production paperwork, downtime logs and shift handovers complete, accurate and on time, and report shift results to the Operations Manager
  • Drive 5S, housekeeping, waste reduction and root-cause problem solving with the team

Essential Criteria:
  • Minimum 3 years’ supervisory or team leader experience in food or FMCG manufacturing
  • Strong working knowledge of GMP, HACCP and food safety requirements
  • Proven ability to lead, train and motivate a team on the floor
  • Confident with rostering and managing labour to budget
  • Good computer skills and accurate record keeping

Desirable:
  • Certificate IV in Food Processing, Leadership or Frontline Management
  • Exposure to Lean, 5S or continuous improvement methods
  • Forklift licence
